Name: networkSize
Short Description: People on the network (computer players fill the seats nobody takes)

Name: minPlayers
Short Description: How many people must be here before the game can start

Name: waitSeconds
Short Description: How long to wait for more people once enough are here (seconds)

Name: prolificCode
Short Description: Prolific completion code, if you recruit there (Prolific participants are shown it at the end)

Name: language
Short Description: The language participants read the texts in: its code on the Content page, e.g. zho (a text not written in it yet is shown in English)
